ranked.headline: Learned embeddings and graph models decode tissue organization from transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell atlases now reach millions of cells, driving models that embed lineage, histology, and neighborhood context.

ranked.headline: ML models infer tumor molecular signatures from histology, MRI, and multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Models now infer tumor molecular programs from routine histology, MRI and multi-omics, increasingly benchmarked against baselines and held-out cohorts.

ranked.headline: Atomic-resolution diffusion and steered sampling extend generative protein design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair diffusion and protein language models with steered sampling, diversity objectives, and fold-bias audits.

ranked.headline: LLM agents convert biomedical literature into executable, auditable research workflows
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM pipelines now extract, verify and execute biomedical knowledge from literature at scale, with provenance and expert oversight.

ranked.headline: Physics-based models probe protein dynamics, allostery and binding-site energetics
ranked.summary: Physics-based descriptors now feed generative design, allosteric site prediction and PTM-conditioned conformational dynamics models.

ranked.headline: Epigenomic and sequence models predict regulatory variants and enhancer-gene links
ranked.summary: Population-scale proteogenomic and regulatory models now link genetic variants to molecular effectors, disease subtypes, and enhancer targets.

ranked.headline: Graph models link single-cell transcriptomic and chromatin data to regulatory structure
ranked.summary: Multiome Perturb-Seq and cross-species scRNA-seq with chromatin accessibility are now modeled with graph-based integration methods.

ranked.headline: Adapting protein language model embeddings for function and structure prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications adapt ESM-2, ESM-C and ProtBert embeddings through new pretraining objectives, fine-tuning and added structural or surface…

ranked.headline: Long-read benchmarks expose accuracy limits in RNA, phasing and methylation calling
ranked.summary: Nanopore and PacBio chemistries, reference choices and simulators are now being validated against ground truth and orthogonal data.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict regulatory motifs, TF binding, and variant effects from sequence
ranked.summary: Protein and genomic language model embeddings are now being fused with DNA and variant inputs to predict binding, motifs, and missense impact.

ranked.headline: Coupling simulation with inference across stochastic and mechanistic biological models
ranked.summary: Numerical precision, trace generation, and inference design are now treated as co-optimized variables in stochastic biological modeling.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings and transformers model microbial and gene-level biological…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair pretrained and species-specific embeddings with transformer and generative models across microbiome and gene-pair data.

ranked.headline: Interactive and LLM-assisted tools for spatial and single-cell omics analysis
ranked.summary: Spatial omics analysis is shifting toward closed-loop, interactive tools that couple statistical modeling with direct spatial visualization.

ranked.headline: GNNs over biological graphs predict PPIs, drug targets, and disease-linked hubs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply graph neural networks to protein interaction, knowledge graph, and drug-target data while encoding explicit biological priors.

ranked.headline: Standardized benchmarks are testing whether binding and screening tools truly generalize
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair curated public datasets with stricter evaluations of binding, design, and virtual screening tools.

ranked.headline: Sample-specific scale distortion in RNA-seq data and pipeline benchmarking
ranked.summary: Recent items address bias in TCGA, SU2C and GTEx expression data alongside pipeline benchmarks for RNA-seq and single-cell methods.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models of single cells draw time cues from chromatin, space and lineage
ranked.summary: Live imaging, scHi-C, RNA velocity and CRISPR barcoding now yield time-informative single-cell data suited to mechanistic dynamical modeling.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for reproducible omics and biochemical network analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool package document reproducible metabolomics, network, proteomics, and single-cell analyses as usable software.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked, reference-independent and variant-tracking tools for microbial genomic data
ranked.summary: Pathogen and metagenomic surveillance increasingly depends on reproducible, benchmarked software for detecting spreading organisms and tracking variants.

ranked.headline: Topology-based simulation and reverse vaccinology target folding and immunogen design
ranked.summary: Preprints pair coarse-grained simulation and reverse vaccinology with a published genomic study linking tick-borne virus ecology to pathogenicity.

ranked.headline: Workflows extract taxonomy and detect contamination from metagenomic sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add pipelines for rRNA read extraction from shotgun data and control-free contamination detection in metagenomic profiles.

ranked.headline: Generative models are restoring, unmixing, and modeling 3D and multiview microscopy data
ranked.summary: Probabilistic generative models now pair microscopy restoration and unmixing with explicit uncertainty estimates and cross-view inference.

ranked.headline: Ancestry- and genealogy-aware association methods with explicit bias control
ranked.summary: Multi-ancestry and genealogy-based cohorts require association designs that gain power while explicitly controlling selection and sample-overlap bias.

ranked.headline: MS peptides mapped beyond canonical genes, from smORFs to PTM structural modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair open-search and de novo peptide identification with error estimation to expand non-canonical proteomes.

ranked.headline: LLM agents linked to omics and clinical tools are being checked against evidence
ranked.summary: Agent systems now span rare disease diagnosis, spatial transcriptomics and single-cell annotation, with new audits testing their generated claims.

ranked.headline: Structure-informed models target multidomain, metalloprotein, and GPCR pharmacology
ranked.summary: Structure-derived representations now feed sequence models for protein design and function prediction across complexes, domains, and receptor families.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved and near-complete plant genomes reveal structural drivers of evolution
ranked.summary: Near-T2T and haplotype-resolved assemblies now resolve polyploid, transposon and structural variation at chromosome scale across crop and wild plants.

ranked.headline: Cohesin bridging and MD simulations probe enhancer-promoter and nucleic acid recognition
ranked.summary: Simulation-based models now span chromatin looping, spliceosomal branch-site recognition, engineered RNA design, and glycosylase lesion recognition.

ranked.headline: Parameterized shape representations linking biological morphology to mechanics and flow
ranked.summary: Three 2026 preprints parameterize planar, fish dorsal, and tissue shapes to quantify morphology or invert mechanical models toward target geometry.

ranked.headline: Deep models learn multiscale representations of DNA, proteins and single cells
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a May 2026 publication extend DNA, protein and single-cell models with regulatory, marker-gene and structural priors.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell evolution, DNA content, and selection from genomic data
ranked.summary: Methods now recover evolutionary and copy-number states from methylation, fragment overlaps, and patient age distributions rather than direct measurements.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools now parse, evaluate, and visualize assembly and pangenome graphs
ranked.summary: Recent releases address evaluation, indexing, and manipulation of assembly graphs, pangenome variation graphs, and biosynthetic gene cluster predictions.

ranked.headline: Information geometry and latent gain models dissect shared neural population variability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study quantify shared variability and noise structure underlying neural population coding and perceptual inference.

ranked.headline: Computational models now resolve splicing and isoform structure from RNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Long-read single-cell and transformer-based approaches are sharpening splice-junction and isoform inference across exon-intron contexts.

ranked.headline: Spectrum-based small molecule structure inference faces benchmark and validity challenges
ranked.summary: Benchmark artifacts in MS/MS annotation and the need for calibrated retrieval are prompting stricter evaluation of small-molecule identification methods.

ranked.headline: Diagnosing when statistical inference fails on genomic, microbiome and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent work stress-tests when GRN, mediation and regression estimators fail on genomic data, alongside new models for compositional and structured inputs.

ranked.headline: Metabolic models tie energetic constraints and enzyme levels to cell growth and disease
ranked.summary: Three preprints apply minimal, ensemble, and homeostatic ODE models to energy metabolism, linking enzyme activity to growth and clinical phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Computational models link bacterial genotype to metabolic and regulatory phenotypes
ranked.summary: Three preprints from May 2026 apply genome-scale modeling, sequence-structure analysis and machine learning to bacterial protein and gene function.

ranked.headline: Cell-resolved atlases and tools link development, evolution and miRNA regulation
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases now span about 300k placental cells across ten mammals, while CLASH and knockout tools extend cross-species reach.

ranked.headline: Spatial layout and phenotypic switching shape selection and invasion in microbial…
ranked.summary: Three 2026 preprints show that spatial layout, genotype specificity, and phenotypic switching set qualitative population outcomes.
